newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, spread widens.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, spread widens.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed, as bull-spreading and flour mill-buying lifted the nearby December contract off its early lows.
As in Kansas City, more emphasis was put on the Dec/March spread, which widened to close at 20-1/2 cents after trading early at between 17 and 18 cents.

The MGE reported Tuesday that there had been a decline in deliverable stocks of spring wheat in Duluth and in the Minneapolis area as of Nov. 15. Stocks of wheat in Minneapolis were listed at 1.8 million bushels, down from 1.94 million during the previous week.
In Duluth, deliverable stocks were listed at 6.49 million bushels, a drop from 8.17 million during the previous week.
MGE spring wheat ended five cents per bushel lower to 1-3/4 cents higher, with December up 1-3/4 cents at $4.00-1/2. March lost two cents to close at $3.80.
Traders said LFG bought 1.2 million March bushels. Atwood/Peavey sold 800,000 March. ADM bought 600,000 March.

Wilson bull-spread at least 800,000 Dec/March bushels. Atwood/Peavey bull-spread 600,000 Dec/March at 17-1/2 cents. Country Hedging and Benson-Quinn each bear-spread at least 500,000 March/Dec, traders said.
MGE barley futures settled five to 10 cents per cwt lower, with December down five cents at $6.70.
